ITEM 1 | Cluster of small dark brown pieces with browned, slightly glossy surfaces and irregular rounded caps, some with pale stems, arranged in a loose mound on the upper left of the plate, roughly 8 cm across and 2 cm high; appears moist and tender, holds its shape | 70
ITEM 2 | Single small dark brown crumb-like fragment sitting separately above the mushroom cluster, about 1 cm across, matte and slightly crisp | 3
ITEM 3 | Slice of pinkish-red meat with a browned, seared outer edge, partly covered by a dark green-brown crust of finely chopped herbs or crumbs and scattered bright green leaf pieces, on the upper right of the plate, about 6 cm by 4 cm and 1.5 cm thick; looks moist and slightly juicy | 90
ITEM 4 | Fresh-looking green herb leaves and small stems scattered over the meat and along its edge, bright green, slightly wet, about 3 cm across total | 4
ITEM 5 | Mound of coarsely mashed pale yellow potato with visible lumps and rough, flaky texture, slightly glossy with a little moisture, spread across the center-lower plate about 11 cm by 8 cm and 2.5 cm high; soft and crumbly, does not hold a firm shape | 180
ITEM 6 | Two chunks of roasted potato with golden-brown, crisp-looking browned outer surfaces and pale yellow interiors, one with small green flecks, lying beside the mash on the right, each about 4 cm by 3 cm and 2 cm thick | 90
